Redesigned under the Cornerstone Phase 3 style, this pedal draws open inspiration from the iconic vintage Italian Vespa — offering not just an innovative neo-vintage tool for your music, but a piece of art for your pedalboard. What About the Sound? The Antique V3 introduces a special boost section called Hot Mode , which provides both a gain boost and a volume boost, each with independent controls. This means you can achieve a wide range of sounds, from subtle enhancements to powerful leads, all in one compact pedal. Why You'll Love the Antique V3 Versatility: Whether you need a clean boost, a crunchy rhythm, or a soaring lead, the Antique V3 delivers with precision. Compact Design: A space-saving solution that can replace multiple pedals on your board. Vintage Inspiration: Perfect for those who appreciate the classic tube screamer sound with modern enhancements.
